finding.title: Secondary scanner usage counted as verifier

verifier.reason: Confirmed: cli.mjs:336 runs the secondary scanner with role scanner-secondary, agents/index.mjs:55 preserves that exact role in callLog, and cli.mjs:566 maps only exact scanner to scanner-correctness with every other role falling through to verifier.

repro.rationale: The usage aggregation at cli.mjs:566 is inline inside the unexported main() function. cli.mjs only exports buildRunBanner, which does not perform or expose callLog/byRole aggregation, and no other listed module exports that aggregation. A faithful test would require executing the guarded full CLI pipeline in dual-scan mode with environment configuration, a target repository, model/mock agents, and filesystem report outputs, then inspecting run.json; its assertions would not be tied to a direct call of an imported symbol as required.
repro.reason: Bug is in unexported inline logic in cli.mjs main(); no exported API exposes secondary-scanner usage aggregation.

finding.claim: extractSpecifiers scans forward for 'from' until ';', so when statements omit semicolons (ASI) the scan crosses statement boundaries and attributes a later import's specifier to an earlier import/export, yielding false or duplicate edges.
finding.title: from-scan uses semicolon terminator crossing ASI boundaries

verifier.reason: The scan at ingest/index.mjs:91 stops only on ';' and pushes the first following 'from' string at ingest/index.mjs:92-94, while the tokenizer discards newlines as whitespace at ingest/index.mjs:48, so a semicolon-less import/export can capture a later import's specifier and push it again when that later import is visited.
